description: Timestamp exactly 5 minutes after receive time. Former live-window boundary, kept to check no window is enforced.

expected_upstream.notes: Upstream has no range check and stores every integer timestamp. Replaying this fixture against Holocron at the exact boundary needs an injectable clock; over HTTP the request takes milliseconds to arrive, which moves an exact boundary by up to one second.

expected_holocron.notes: Confirmed (Mike, 2026-10-03): no payload is refused for its event time, matching upstream (docs/decisions/0002, Event time; docs/decisions/0005, Event time outcomes). Respond only after the payload is durably committed (briefing, durability). Keep the {cache, sessionId, visitId} shape (briefing, identity). Values come from the identity derivation in docs/decisions/0001, so they will not equal upstream values. Exactly 5 minutes ahead is not counted in event_time_ahead (the counter is for more than 5 minutes ahead, docs/decisions/0002).

validation_reason: Replayed against official Umami 3.4.0 by tools/collection-harness/replay.mjs. Result in docs/evidence/m01-collection-validation.md.
